title: Slash J mod
description: for all the people who tried to write "/j" as a separate message.
body:
# Hook
How often have you tried to write "/j" in chat, only for the game to register it as an invalid 
command? I have, so that's why I made this mod.

# Description
It's really simple, all it adds is one command, and that is the fabled "/j".
Typing this command in chat sends a message in chat saying that whatever you said was simply a joke!
Have fun.
